crop.notes: The clipping is real estate transfers, 'May Be Prosecuted' (Alaska Mining Co.) and the start of an Austin court item. The Allen item ('Tom Allen ... Badly Beaten') is further down the same column, below 'Important Precedent Established' and above 'Free Fireworks for the Boys'; a tear runs through it.

ocr.notes: Transcript is of the wrong items; it has no Allen text.

title.suggested: Tom Allen Badly Beaten in Front of His Market Street Saloon

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen was badly beaten in front of his saloon on Market Street near Sixth early that morning; shots missed him, and his barkeeper came to his rescue.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Friday Morning, July 1, 1898. Allen item read from the full page image; a tear hides words in the middle of each line.

facts.fact: Allen was badly beaten in front of his saloon on Market Street near Sixth early on July 1, 1898; he was at first reported shot but the bullets missed, and his barkeeper came to his rescue
places: Allen's saloon, Market Street near Sixth, St. Louis

facts.fact: In 1898 Allen's saloon was on Market Street near Sixth, St. Louis
